title: 丝芙兰AI顾问：上传自拍，但你的肤质数据会被如何保护？
speaker: Lisa Mateo

segments.en: Nadine Graham senior vice president and general manager of e-commerce for Sephora says there's also a digital version. So you upload a selfie it scans the selfie it figures out your primary concerns and then provides a contextual overlay and then creates a four step product routine.
segments.zh: 丝芙兰电商高级副总裁兼总经理Nadine Graham表示，还有数字版本。上传自拍后，它会扫描并识别你的主要问题，然后提供情境叠加，并创建四步产品流程。

segments.en: Add to that an AI beauty chat. We have product recommendations for them expert advice.
segments.zh: 再加上AI美妆聊天，提供产品推荐和专家建议。

segments.en: Elf Beauty uses a global digital experience called color Elf Nalysis. Chief technology and AI officer Ecta Chopra describes it as a place where users discover makeup shades to compliment their features and get matched with the Pinterest board of Elf products.
segments.zh: Elf Beauty使用名为Color Elf Nalysis的全球数字体验。首席技术兼AI官Ecta Chopra称，用户可在此发现适合自己特征的妆容色调，并匹配Elf产品的Pinterest画板。

segments.en: Now they can go in and use this tool to say, hey, during these seasons, what colors would look good on me? You know, so that's sort of the idea is like how do we use AI in meaningful ways?
segments.zh: 用户可以使用这个工具询问，比如‘这个季节什么颜色适合我？’这就是我们如何有意义地使用AI。

segments.en: But what about a product you can only smell like perfume as Day Lauder is using an AI chatbot built for its Joe Malone London fragrance. Chief technology data and analytics officer Brian France says description is key.
segments.zh: 那么像香水这样只能闻的产品呢？雅诗兰黛为祖·玛珑伦敦香水打造了AI聊天机器人。首席技术、数据与分析官Brian France表示，描述是关键。

segments.en: I really like what feels like in on the coast of London when I smell the ocean or I smell the grass. And when you start to like just speak to it, you start to have a conversation with the large language model.
segments.zh: 我喜欢伦敦海岸的感觉，闻到海洋或青草的气息。当你开始与它对话，就是与大型语言模型交流。

segments.en: It's interpreting everything you're saying. And then it's matching. We have an olfactory taxonomy that we use to try to understand all the senses and then it matches up.
segments.zh: 它理解你所说的一切，然后进行匹配。我们使用嗅觉分类法来理解所有感官，然后进行匹配。

segments.en: And so trying to bring together technology but like the real secret sauce is the data and really kind of looking at what do our sent advisors and our beauty advisors in the store do with consumers. Is it working? Are our consumers working?
segments.zh: 将技术融合，但真正的秘诀是数据，以及观察我们的香氛顾问和店内美妆顾问如何与消费者互动。这有效吗？我们的消费者是否买账？
